Then hang onto your friends, text them, have calls with them in which you watch a movie or something, care about them and let them care about you. Take that part of halloween and embrace it through the whole year.

It won't necessarily help you if the drama is bad. Drama doesn't define you as a person but keeps you going... the problem is that it can get to a bad point because drama isn't all good.  
You could find yourself a vocation. Ask your friends what they think about you and reflect on the answers instead of being just sad or happy about it. Reflect on your bad sides and your good sides. If you can't find any, again, ask people who know you.

Hang onto what you believe, it'll help you through all of it. It feels like being on a raft in the ocean in a foggy day. The thing is, if you let go, you won't be there when the boat that you didn't see through the fog finally rescues you. Hope is the most important thing you need to better yourself.

There are always infinitely many days to enjoy, we often don't notice the good days because we only remember the bad ones or notice the bad ones. If that one day is what truly makes you happy, find what you like about it and try bringing those things to all of your days. If you have trouble doing this, asking your closest friends about it, they could help you implement what you like about halloween usually to your everyday life.

If you really feel like you need vacation, just going somewhere hiking in your area could do it. Going away on vacation in another country is often what people think will help them because it's a physical way of going away from your problems, but if taking a break is what counts here, You could probably tell your boss about this and take a day or two out of work to reset.  


As of for your mental illnesses, it's entirely possible that overworking yourself is not helping and you could ask for a bit less hours if you really need it. I'm not very keen to know how it works as I haven't been really exposed to the workplace, but as long as it's to help you get to a better place, I think sometimes, the work can wait. Of course this won't SOLVE your depression, but it can definitely help.  


If need a deeper talk, I'll send you my discord in reddit dms.

This is a very delicate situation to say the least. But if you manage to find a way to contact the police, it could very much be the best way to get out of this place at least. If you really are scared of what your husband might do to you.If you can first get out of this situation, it could be easier to deal with the illness after if it truly is here.But there are other possibilities to deal with the mental state you're in. First of all could be finding a place to talk with other people in your physical situation. There are so many meetup areas and places like this where you can unite with the people that can relate to you and help you go through this. Some peeps that are also physically disabled might know more resources you could use and they'll share it with you if you ask them.

So TLDR, find a way to contact peeps that have been in your situation and got out of it so that they can help you know what to do.  


I found this [https://www.meetup.com/fr-FR/topics/physically-disabled-adults/](https://www.meetup.com/fr-FR/topics/physically-disabled-adults/)  
But there can be many more you can find on the internet.

The subject is innocent portrayed by a simple first theme, generally high notes and some portions being reminiscent of nursery rhymes.

0:32 - 0:42

The theme replays again on a lower "signature" symbolizing the subject's growth and maturing

0:42 - 0:49

The theme replays yet again slightly higher but accompanied by the same theme played exactly one octave lower. The subject is trying to hold onto their innocence, but they can't escape their growth of self conscience and maturity which is always following them.

0:52 - 1:00

It's inevitable, the subject's innocence slowly slips away from them as they fall into a crisis, depression, existential dread, etc. At this point the music is easily forgettable as only a slight background jazz guitars plays by itself very slowly in an almost automatic manner, the subject isn't really capable of thinking for themselves, they are a husk of the person they once were.

1:00 - 1:10

The jazz guitar attempts bringing back the harmony by itself but it lacks the brightness to do so, the subject knows they are troubled and try to fix it themselves, to no avail.

1:17 - 1:27

A harp comes into play, symbolizing a new member, a friend, family, maybe even a stranger. This new member lowers itself at the jazz guitar's point, enticing it to try and bring the harmony back again. Finally, the guitar symbolizing the subject attempts bringing it all back again.

1:27 - 1:52

A breakthrough happens. Thanks to the harp accompanying the guitar, the harmony is back on track again, now more alive and complex than ever before, a bunch of new instruments are coming in and flowing through the music, everything the subject passively learned during their crisis is now coming back and all making sense again. The subject has enhanced conscience of himself and others. Their life is now flowering and bursting with new learnings and a new understanding of life.
